rules.sentence: - T4a (moderately advanced local disease): Tumor >4 cm with DOI >10 mm or tumor invading adjacent structures (through the cortical bone of the mandible or maxilla, or involving the maxillary sinus or skin of the face)
◦ Note: Superficial erosion of the bone or tooth socket by a primary gingival tumor alone does not qualify for T4 category.
- T4b (very advanced local disease): Tumor invading the masticator space, pterygoid plates, or skull base and/or encasing the internal carotid artery
